strings.name: Daniela Amodei
strings.summary: Daniela Amodei is Anthropic’s co-founder, president and board chair. With a background in literature, she entered technology and worked in recruiting, risk operations, people management and safety policy at Stripe and OpenAI. She founded Anthropic with her brother Dario and other co-founders, taking organizational and business responsibilities. Claude is a team achievement; the company’s safety goals do not mean model risks have been eliminated.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Uses SEC employment records and university degree information, distinguishing shared company achievements from personal responsibilities. An IPO filing is not a completed listing; birth is recorded only to the year.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Anthropic, contributed to its organization and commercial development, and helped connect safety research with product applications.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Graduated from UC Santa Cruz in 2009 with a BA in literature and a minor in politics.
strings.facts.f2.label: Professional focus
strings.facts.f2.value: Organizational management, recruiting and risk operations, followed by AI company operations and governance.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Co-founding Anthropic
strings.highlights.h1.text: Established the company with six other co-founders and has served as president and director since January 2021.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Connecting research and management
strings.highlights.h2.text: Applies people-management and risk-operations experience to building an AI company; her management contributions are distinguished from the research team’s technical results.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Signs amended IPO registration
strings.timeline.t1.text: Signs the S-1/A as president, co-founder and director; this documents the offering application stage.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Named to TIME100
strings.timeline.t2.text: Included with her brother Dario in TIME’s annual list of 100 influential people, as reported by her university.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Anthropic introduces Claude
strings.timeline.t3.text: The company releases the Claude AI assistant, a product milestone at the company she helps lead rather than her independent invention.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Co-founds Anthropic
strings.timeline.t4.text: Establishes the company with Dario and five other co-founders, becoming president and director.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Leaves OpenAI
strings.timeline.t5.text: Her tenure ends after roles including vice president of safety and policy, vice president of people, and engineering manager.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joins OpenAI
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moves from payment technology into an AI research organization, subsequently holding several management positions.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joins Stripe
strings.timeline.t7.text: Becomes an early employee, initially in recruiting and later in risk operations; remains until July 2018.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earns a bachelor’s degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completes a literature degree and a politics minor at UC Santa Cruz.
